title: Enantioselective cyclization reactions involving 3-isothiocyanato oxindoles: synthesis of spirocycles
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,26639-26658
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01468B, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mohammad Hadi Edareh, Fatemeh Doraghi, Arman Farahani, Mehran Ghasemi, Mohammad Mahdavi
As a powerful ambiphilic synthon, 3-isothiocyanato oxindoles react effectively with diverse electron-deficient unsaturated bonds under organocatalysis or metal catalysis systems towards the synthesis of biologically important spirocyclic scaffolds.
